title: Pydantic v2: validating external data

spans.text: Python type hints help readers and static analysis, but do not validate incoming JSON at runtime. Pydantic v2 models parse external dictionaries or JSON into typed values and enforce declared constraints. Use

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Install Pydantic v2 in the active virtual environment with `python -m pip install 'pydantic>=2,<3'` and pin the version in the project.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Map validation errors to safe user-facing responses and never log secrets. Pydantic v1 examples do not use the same API as v2.
